correctness.rationale: PASS: The full one-block zip map Fτ on Z^{negative}×S^{nonnegative} is onto with pointwise inverse degree δ(x)=|τ^-1(x_{-1})|=d_{x_-1}, a topological-conjugacy invariant by bijection of inverse fibers. Exactly |S| fixed points are indexed by constant forward symbol s and have degree d_{τ(s)}; hence Iτ(v)=Σ_z d_z v^{d_z}. Its coefficient at v^d divided by d recovers the number of target fibers of size d. Equal multisets permit explicit bijections α:S→S′ and β:Z→Z′ with ρ∘α=β∘τ, giving coordinatewise conjugacy of the full zip systems. Thus conjugacy classes at |S|=N are partitions of N. Periodic words w∈S^n yield exactly N^n fixed points; degree-weighted sums factor as (Σ_z d_z^{r+1})^n, giving rational ζ_{τ,r}. The projection from full bilateral S-shift proves natural extension and entropy logN. Independently enumerated all finite surjections with 1≤N≤5 and recovered 1,2,3,5,7 distinct inverse-degree polynomials, equal to partition counts; bounded checks are not the all-N proof.
